Subject: Post-demo follow-up - Marketplace private offer mapping

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo today - it was helpful to see the throughput and latency for the 7B quantized model. A couple of follow-ups from our side as we start procurement: 

1) Token volume profile: we estimated 200M tokens/day (peak) with 50M tokens/day sustained initially. We expect growth to ~500M/day over 12 months if the pilot goes well.
2) Budget range: we have an initial monthly budget of ~$40k- $60k for the pilot phase; target $/1M tokens for production is a conversation point.
3) Marketplace path: our procurement team prefers an AWS Private Offer via the Marketplace. We need to map Redwood's unit economics to the Private Offer price (including AWS margins / list price mapping) so we can put a PO in.

Can you confirm: (a) a reasonable host/unit price target $/1M tokens for an AWS private offer (ballpark), (b) how dedicated/reserved capacity would change the unit economics, and (c) typical lead times to get a Private Offer in place?

Elena (cc'd) is our procurement lead - looping her in for next steps.

Thanks,
Sam

Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up - Marketplace private offer mapping

Hi Sam / Elena - great to meet you both earlier. Quick recap and ballpark pricing so you have something to take to procurement. I kept the internal math explicit so the private-offer mapping is transparent.

Recap of model + workload assumptions:
- Model: redwood-7b-quant (serving profile used in demo)
- Expected throughput: 50M tokens/day sustained (pilot), 200M/day peak, growth to 500M/day on scale

Redwood-hosted (standard API) unit economics (ballpark):
- List/reference price (hosted API): ~$12 / 1M tokens for the redwood-7b-quant serving profile (this is our public-facing hosted price tier for on-demand usage).
- For high sustained volumes we can index to a lower unit: ~$8 / 1M tokens with a committed monthly volume or reserved capacity.

Dedicated / Reserved capacity economics:
- Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit): effectively reduces equivalent unit to ~$5-6 / 1M tokens for the sustained load in your profile (depends on commit and effective utilization). This assumes a 6-12 month commit and typical batching/caching efficiencies.

Marketplace private offer mapping guidance (AWS Marketplace):
- AWS Marketplace Private Offer typically needs a list/units mapping. The private-offer price often includes a marketplace surcharge and/or customer-specific discount off our list.
- Example mapping (illustrative):
   - Redwood list: $12 / 1M tokens (hosted on-demand)
   - Target private-offer price to Acme (cloud-borne): $10-12 / 1M tokens for pilot (reflects small volume discount and marketplace fees)
   - If you want the Dedicated economics reflected in the PO, we can map reserved capacity to an equivalent $6-7 / 1M tokens for the committed volume in the PO (requires explicit term & monthly commitment).

Notes on fees & margins:
- Marketplace fees and any reseller margins vary by program - internal rule of thumb: expect ~10-20% of list to be absorbed by listing/partner adjustments. We bake this into the suggested private-offer price.

Operational / timeline notes: 
- Private Offer process: typically 1-3 weeks once commercial terms are agreed and Marketplace team prepares the offer (DocuSign + AWS-side processing). If legal requires extra review, add 1-2 weeks.
- What we need from you to start: (1) confirm target unit price (pilot vs committed), (2) target contract term and monthly committed tokens (if you want dedicated mapping), (3) procurement contact / billing entity + billing address.

Attachments: I attached a short PDF that shows the mapping matrix (hosted vs reserved vs marketplace) and a private-offer template for procurement.

Proposed next steps:
- Elena: can you confirm if you prefer the PO to reflect dedicated reserved capacity (commit) or a pilot on hosted private offer?
- We (Redwood) will draft a Marketplace Private Offer template and a sample PO that shows the $/1M mapping.
- If you want the dedicated price, we’ll follow up with a SOW for committed capacity.

Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa

2) Optional reserved capacity (12 mo) - equivalent unit priced at $6.50 / 1M tokens for committed monthly volume of 150M tokens (start month 4)

Also need invoice instructions and Redwood's legal contact for the private-offer terms.
